reviews.t: Best scrub for my sensitive skin!
reviews.x: I bought a couple of scrubs recently, and this one is the absolute best. I definitely don't need moisturizer after using this one, and I feel buttery soft. It also has an amazing but very natural smell. Love it! It is also worth noting I have extremely sensitive skin and react to MANY products, but had no issue with this!!!!

I bought this body scrub because I have perpetually dry skin. I did receive this item at a discounted rate in return for an honest, unbiased review.  Ok, so the first thing I noticed about this body scrub is that every ingredient used in it is all natural, which is something I appreciate. Using the scrub is very simple- just rub it onto your skin when it's slightly damp and let it sit for a few minutes. When I washed the scrub off my skin, my legs were instantly silky. reviews.t: The best body scrub I have ever used
reviews.x: I absolutely love this body scrub! It smells incredible and leaves your body silky soft, you do not even need to use lotion after the scrub, I love this product so much will be ordering more and more !

I've re-ordered this magical stuff atleast 5 times now. I'm prone to ingrown hairs and bumps on my inner thighs and back of my thighs. Using atlesst 2x a week I stay baby smooth! Clears out a leg break out/irritation in just a couple days. This stuff is amazing and worth every penny. It's so effective for razor bumps that they need to change their marketing to reflect that. Great product, no harsh chemicals or ingredients. It leaves your body feeling smooth and silky. I use It once a week. Smells wonderful and I feel so pampered when I use it. The salt dissolves pretty quick I try to wet it a little bit only so a little goes along way.

The jar is a bit smaller than I expected, but as someone else here noted, you only need a little at a time. It gives a good rough scrub, and when you rinse, leaves a nice moisturizing layer behind that is not at all greasy or gooey. In the jar it does have a very strong coconut smell, and I was afraid I would walk around smelling like a pina colada; but once you wash it off, it leaves a very faintly pleasant smell that is actually very nice.

I love it. My daughter suffers from dry skin, so I regularly make her body scrubs, and I just love it for myself. Melted coconut oil and sea salt are my main ingredients, so naturally I wanted something that would match that. This does. For those saying it was dry, perhaps mixing the product would have helped (settling is real) or check your expiration date. Could have been a bad one. reviews.t: I like it but not what I expected
reviews.x: I like it but not what I expected. When I received it I read the directions and they said to leave it on until it dries..5-10mins. I don't really have time for that so I just exfoliate and wash off. Still nice but it almost seems like its more of a mask than a scrub.

reviews.t: this is the best thing since sliced bread <3
reviews.x: I looooveeee this product!!! it makes my skin feel like a chocolate godiva goddess....and it makes it so smooth and silky soft...too bad I don't have anyone to enjoy the luxuriousness of my new Baebody Coconut Milk Body Scrub with me :-( oh well

I received it quick and fast, I used it the same day but I can't figure out what all the hype is about. Smell was decent in container but the scent doesn't stay on your skin once you leave the shower. My skin also didn't feel softer. I loved the presentation of the packaging it's cute and simple but aside from that I say skip it.

reviews.t: it slipped right through my fingers like dry sand
reviews.x: Once I scooped some up, it slipped right through my fingers like dry sand. Impossible to use.  So I looked at the FIVE STAR reviews, and, once again, they are mainly UNverified purchases.  Allowing sellers to buy fake reviews to increase the ratings which misleads buyers really lowers the standards of the website.

The seal was broken under the lid when I received the package causing all of the coconut oil liquid to leak out leaving me with a dry scrub. Beware this is a scrub containing salt and you can certainly feel it on any razor knicks, scratches or sensitive skin areas.
Box was oil stained and when we opened the box the scrub oil had completely leaked out.

reviews.t: Gentle and effective! Good for sensitive and dry skin!
reviews.x: No complaints. If it helps anyone, I have KP or "chicken skin" condition on my arms and this scrub is soothing, non irritating and it seems to be smoothing my skin all over. I'll say, if you're looking for a really gritty scrub, it's not like that as the salt grains dissolve pretty quickly. But, if you have sensitive skin that just needs gentle exfoliation, this is perfect!

reviews.t: My wife says its the best she has ever used
reviews.x: Regarding the Baebody Coconut Milk Body Scrub: My wife says its the best she has ever used, silky smooth and clean feeling.  Feels just like exiting a Korean bathhouse.  It is that good.  We will be buying more for gifts to our girls...

reviews.t: Very disappointed in this product - came with absolutely no liquid ...
reviews.x: Very disappointed in this product - came with absolutely no liquid in it, just bone dry scrub. I do like the smell but for what I paid, I was not happy with this.

As other reviewers have noted, this product is rather crumbly and difficult to use as just as much falls off into the shower as I can get on my skin.  I know there are beneficial oils in it because I can see the water beading up on my skin after I use it and my skin definitely looks and feels better.  I made the mistake of using a dry razor on my legs one day when I was in a hurry and the resulting rash had lasted for months, finally disappearing with the use of this product.  But back to the cr

My ordered arrived asked I couldn't wait to try it. Once I opened it I noticed it hardly had a scent which was disappointing. Then when I attempted to scoop some of the product into my damp hand it made a mess and more ended up in my tub than in my hand. It reminded me of sand when you scoop up a handful. I attempted to use and had to keep going back for more and each time I did it would just fall through my fingers like sand. After my shower I air dried and noticed my skin was dry and I still h

Not sure if I received a bad batch, but it was completely dry so it's more like salt that falls off unless you strategically avoid gravity while putting it on...will try other methods and maybe add some coconut oil to it, but already more work than I anticipated.. I expected some sort of liquidy-ness to it rather than just salt texture...?
Super dry.  Not luxurious.  Don't waste your money.  Better products out there.

I had this on my wish list for a while before I purchased it. I read the reviews and figured I'd give it a shot. It is not very luxurious, it's average body scrub at best. It's not very coconut or very moisturizing. It is a body scrub- however, I've had way better body scrub for the price. I wouldn't buy it again.

Paid a fortune for a bottle of loose, dry, sea salt.  No oil, coconut milk, or anything else to make this a "coconut milk" body scrub.  The foil seal was broken, but the plastic wrap around the container was intact, like they just re-wrapped a defective product and sent it out.  Super not happy.

I like that this product is truly all natural ingredients. It smells like coconuts so that is nice. But there is so much salt in it that it feels pretty harsh when I use it. And the smell goes away very quickly.  If you have very dry skin it might be better for you.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scrub for leaving skin soft, silky, and moisturized, often noting they don't need lotion afterward.
Many reviewers love the natural coconut scent and the all-natural ingredients.
Several reviewers report packaging problems, with oil leaking out and leaving the scrub dry.
A few reviewers found the product disappointing, citing lack of lasting scent, no softening effect, or a texture that slips through fingers like dry sand.
Some reviewers note the scrub can sting on sensitive areas or razor knicks and that the salt dissolves quickly.

qa.q: Does it leave a greasy residue?
qa.answer: The reviews do not describe a greasy residue; instead, one reviewer notes water beading on the skin and skin feeling smooth and silky after use [3][4].

claims.text: One reviewer notes water beading up on the skin after use, indicating oils in the product [3].
Another reviewer says it leaves the body feeling smooth and silky [4].

qa.q: How strong is the coconut scent?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the coconut scent as very strong in the jar [2], though one reviewer found it only decent in the container [4]. Multiple reviewers note the scent fades quickly or doesn't linger on the skin after washing [1][2][4].

claims.text: In the jar it has a very strong coconut smell.
One reviewer found the smell only decent in the container.
The smell goes away very quickly.
Once washed off, it leaves only a very faintly pleasant smell.
The scent doesn't stay on your skin once you leave the shower.

qa.q: Is it gentle enough for sensitive skin?
qa.answer: Yes, multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report it is gentle and non-irritating [1][2]. One reviewer with extremely sensitive skin who reacts to many products had no issue with it [2].

claims.text: A reviewer with sensitive and dry skin found it soothing, non-irritating, and perfect for gentle exfoliation [1].
A reviewer with extremely sensitive skin who reacts to many products had no issue with this scrub [2].

qa.q: How long does a 10oz jar last?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it help with dry skin or keratosis pilaris?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews say it helps with dry skin and keratosis pilaris: one reviewer with KP on their arms found it soothing, non-irritating, and smoothing [1], and another uses it for their daughter's dry skin [3]. It also leaves skin feeling soft without needing moisturizer [6].

claims.text: A reviewer with KP on their arms found the scrub soothing, non-irritating, and smoothing [1].
A reviewer uses it for their daughter who suffers from dry skin [3].
A reviewer says they don't need moisturizer after using it and feel buttery soft [6].
